note: Dimensions in metres from public reference sources, rounded; 'approx' marks figures that vary between sources. 1 block = 1 metre at 1:1 scale.

landmarks.name: Eiffel Tower
features: four curved lattice legs that splay outward and meet into a single shaft above the 2nd platform
decorative semicircular arches spanning between the legs below the 1st platform
three platforms with railings; 1st platform is a deep square ring
the leg profile is concave (exponential), steepest near the top
antenna mast at the tip
landmarks.minecraft: Build each leg as a hollow 'loft' that leans inward (offset dx/dz with height), skin it with 'truss' lattices, join the legs into one tapering loft above 115. Arches between legs with 'arch' or 'lines'. At 1:1 it needs ~330 blocks of height, which does not fit above sea level, so use 2:3 (220 tall, 83 base) or 1:2 (165 tall, 63 base).

landmarks.name: Colosseum (Flavian Amphitheatre)
features: elliptical plan
three storeys of 80 arches each, framed by engaged columns: Tuscan/Doric (ground), Ionic (2nd), Corinthian (3rd)
solid attic storey with Corinthian pilasters and small square windows, plus corbels for the velarium masts
tiered seating (cavea) sloping down to the arena wall
partially ruined south-east side where the outer ring is missing (optional)
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1 (189 x 48 x 156). The plan is an ellipse, so use 'shape' with an ellipse inequality for the hollow ring, e.g. (x-cx)^2/94^2 + (z-cz)^2/78^2 <= 1 and not inside the inner ellipse, then cut the 80 arches per storey with 'shape' using the angle variable a (mod(a, 4.5) < 2.6) or with repeated arches.

landmarks.name: Taj Mahal
landmarks.era: 1648, white Makrana marble on red sandstone
features: square mausoleum with chamfered corners (an irregular octagon)
on each face a huge central iwan (pointed arch portal, pishtaq) flanked by two stacked smaller arched alcoves
onion dome on a cylindrical drum with a lotus top and gilded finial
four small domed chhatris around the main dome
four free-standing minarets at the plinth corners, each with two balconies and a small chhatri
long reflecting pool and charbagh garden in front; red sandstone mosque and guest house to the sides

palette.garden: water, birch/cypress-like spruce trees, smooth_stone paths

landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1. Plinth with 'polygon' or 'fill', body with 'polygon' (8-point chamfered square), iwans with 'arch' style pointed, dome with 'revolve' profile bulging wider than the drum ([[0,9],[4,10.5],[9,10],[13,7],[16,3],[18,0.8],[22,0]] above the drum), minarets with 'revolve' plus 'ring' balconies.

landmarks.name: Notre-Dame de Paris
features: west facade: three portals at the base, the Gallery of Kings, the rose window level, an open gallery, and two square towers without spires
flying buttresses all around the nave and the apse (chevet)
slender lead-covered spire over the crossing
steep lead roof over the nave
transept rose windows north and south
gargoyles and pinnacles
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1 (128 x 96 x 48). Nave as hollow 'polygon' or 'fill', pointed roof with 'roof' pitch 2-3, buttress arcs with 'lines' or 'arch', rose window with 'shape' (radial pattern by a and r), spire with 'revolve' sides 8.

landmarks.name: Big Ben (Elizabeth Tower)
features: tall square shaft with vertical Perpendicular Gothic panelling
four large clock faces with gilded surrounds
open belfry above the clocks
steep cast-iron pyramidal spire with lucarnes and pinnacles
attached to the Palace of Westminster
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1; a great showcase of 'facade_grid' panelling and 'shape' clock faces.

landmarks.name: Empire State Building
landmarks.era: 1931, Art Deco, Indiana limestone and aluminium
features: broad 5-storey base filling the block
series of setbacks (wedding-cake massing) into a slender shaft
continuous vertical piers with recessed windows and aluminium spandrels
stepped crown and the mooring mast with the antenna
landmarks.minecraft: At 1:1 it is too tall; use 1:2 (191 tall to the roof). Massing with stacked 'loft' sections (pairs of sections at the same h for sharp setbacks), skin with 'facade_grid' or 'materials' stripes (mod(x,3)==0 piers).

landmarks.name: Burj Khalifa
features: Y-shaped tripartite plan (three wings around a hexagonal core)
the wings step back one by one in an upward spiral
silver glass and stainless steel cladding with vertical fins
very tall telescoping spire
landmarks.minecraft: Must be scaled: 1:4 gives 207 blocks. Model each wing as a 'loft' whose length shrinks at its setbacks, three wings 120 degrees apart around a central 'revolve' core; spire with 'revolve'.

landmarks.name: Great Pyramid of Giza
features: square base aligned to the compass
originally smooth white Tura limestone casing with a capstone
today stepped core courses visible
entrance on the north face about 17 m up
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1 (230 x 147 x 230). Use 'loft' with a square section shrinking to 0 or 'pyramid' per course; hollow:true keeps it cheap (a solid one is about 2.6 million blocks).

landmarks.name: Parthenon
features: peripteral octastyle Doric temple: 8 columns across each end, 17 along each side (corners counted twice)
three-step crepidoma base
entablature with triglyphs and metopes
low triangular pediments at both ends
inner cella with a second row of 6 columns at each porch
landmarks.minecraft: Small at 1:1 (70 x 14 x 31); 2:1 makes a stronger in-game landmark. Columns with 'revolve' (slight entasis profile) or 'cylinder', repeated with 'copy'.

landmarks.name: St. Peter's Basilica
features: giant Corinthian order facade with an attic and statues
Michelangelo's ribbed dome on a drum with paired columns and a lantern
two smaller satellite domes
Latin cross plan
Bernini's elliptical colonnade in front (St. Peter's Square, 240 m wide, four rows of columns)

palette.dome: light_gray_concrete, lead grey (polished_andesite) with white ribs

landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1 within 512 x 320 x 512 when ground is near sea level. Dome with 'revolve' ([[0,29],[10,29],[30,24],[42,14],[48,5]]), ribs via 'materials' (mod(a,22.5)<2).

landmarks.name: Sagrada Familia
features: 18 spires in total: 12 apostles (bell towers, four per facade), 4 evangelists, the Virgin Mary and the tallest Jesus Christ with a cross
perforated, tapering, parabolic bell towers topped by colourful mosaic finials
three facades: Nativity (organic, sculptural), Passion (angular, bone-like), Glory
tree-like branching columns inside
landmarks.minecraft: At 1:1 the Jesus tower needs 173 blocks of height above the ground. Bell towers with 'revolve' using a parabolic profile and 'materials' openings (mod(y,4)==0 && mod(a,30)<8 -> air).

landmarks.name: Tower Bridge
features: two Gothic stone towers on piers in the river
bascule central span that lifts
two high-level walkways between the tower tops
suspension side spans hung from curved chains to the shore abutments
turrets with pointed roofs at the tower corners
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1. Towers with modules (square_tower with spire corners), walkways and chains with 'truss' and 'lines'.

landmarks.name: Golden Gate Bridge
features: two Art Deco towers with stepped portal bracing
main cables in a sagging catenary between the towers, vertical suspenders
International Orange colour
landmarks.minecraft: Far too long at 1:1 for one design (envelope limit 512). Build one tower and a section of span, or use 1:6 (main span 213, towers 38).

landmarks.name: Leaning Tower of Pisa
features: cylindrical bell tower
ground storey with 15 blind arches
six open gallery storeys, each ringed by an arcade of about 30 columns
smaller recessed bell chamber on top
the lean
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1 or 2:1. A lean of 4 degrees is about 4 blocks of offset over 56 m: model it as a stack of 'revolve' rings (or a 'loft' with dx increasing by 0.07 per block). Keep every ring overlapping the one below so nothing floats.

landmarks.name: Sydney Opera House
features: massive granite-clad podium with broad steps
two main clusters of interlocking shell 'sails' plus a smaller restaurant cluster
shells are sections of a sphere, covered with white and cream chevron tiles
glass walls filling the open ends of the shells
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1. Each sail is a 'shape' made from a sphere cut by planes, e.g. inside sphere of radius 75 centred low and to one side, and on one side of a tilted plane; use hollow with thickness 1.

landmarks.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
features: narrow ridge-top site with the castle stretching along it
tall white limestone palace (Palas) with steep blue-grey roofs
slender round and square towers with conical roofs
red-brick gatehouse
balconies, oriels and galleries facing the gorge
landmarks.minecraft: Built on a cliff: survey the site and add a rock base with 'shape' using noise. Dimensions are approximate.

landmarks.name: Himeji Castle
features: sloped stone base (musha-gaeshi curve)
white plastered walls
five layered roofs with chidori (triangular) and kara-hafu (curved) gables
three smaller keeps linked to the main keep
shachihoko ornaments on the ridges
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1 or 2:1. Use 'pagoda' modules as a starting point, the 'roof' op with flare, and a curved base with 'loft' or 'shape' ((r grows as y falls)).

landmarks.name: Angkor Wat
features: quincunx of five lotus-bud towers, the central one tallest
three concentric rectangular galleries rising in tiers
long causeway with naga balustrades across the moat
bas-relief galleries
landmarks.minecraft: The full complex is too large; build the temple (galleries and five towers, about 215 x 65 x 187) at 1:1. Towers with 'revolve' sides 8 and a stepped, bulging profile.

landmarks.name: Petronas Twin Towers
features: floor plan is an eight-pointed star (two overlapping squares) with semicircles filling the inner corners
setbacks near the top, ending in pinnacles
double-deck skybridge between the towers at the 41st/42nd floors
landmarks.minecraft: Scale 1:2 (226 tall). The star plan is a 'shape' or 'polygon' (16 points); loft the setbacks with several sections.

landmarks.name: Chrysler Building
features: terraced crown of stainless steel arches with triangular windows (sunburst pattern)
needle spire
eagle gargoyles at the 61st floor and radiator-cap ornaments at the 31st
dark brick piers and white brick with grey bands
landmarks.minecraft: Scale 1:2 (160 tall). The crown: stacked 'revolve' bands of decreasing radius with arched cut-outs via 'materials'.

landmarks.name: Space Needle
features: three pairs of curved legs forming an hourglass (narrow waist about two thirds up)
flying-saucer top house with an observation deck and halo
central core with elevators
spire on top
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1. The legs are 'lines' or 'loft' sections; the saucer is 'revolve'.

landmarks.name: Arc de Triomphe
features: one great barrel-vaulted arch on the long faces, smaller transverse arches on the short faces
massive piers with sculpture groups
deep cornice and attic with shields
landmarks.minecraft: Small at 1:1; 2:1 reads better. 'arch' style round, carved with carve:true.

landmarks.name: Pantheon
features: rotunda whose interior fits a perfect sphere
coffered concrete dome with an open oculus
stepped rings on the dome exterior
portico of 8 front Corinthian columns (16 total) with a pediment
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1. Dome with 'revolve' (hollow) of radius 22 plus 'materials' coffers (mod(a,11)<1 || mod(y,4)==0) and leave the top opening.

landmarks.name: Hagia Sophia
features: central dome on pendentives, ringed by 40 small windows at its base
two half-domes east and west extending the nave
massive buttresses
four Ottoman minarets at the corners
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1.

landmarks.name: Hall of Supreme Harmony (Forbidden City)
features: three-tiered white marble terrace with balustrades and stairways
double-eaved hip roof (wudian) with yellow glazed tiles and ridge beasts
red columns and walls, 11 bays across
intricate dougong brackets under the eaves
landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1; use 'roof' hip with flare and two eaves.

landmarks.name: Great Wall of China (section)
features: wall follows ridgelines, climbing and descending with stairs
crenellated parapet on the outer side, low wall on the inner side
two-storey brick watchtowers with arched windows
landmarks.minecraft: Follow the terrain: use the site's height map. Build a section 300-500 blocks long.

landmarks.name: Stonehenge
features: outer ring of 30 upright sarsens capped by continuous lintels
inner horseshoe of five larger trilithons
bluestone circle and horseshoe
surrounding ditch and bank
landmarks.minecraft: Small at 1:1; 3:1 (99 across) makes a grand monument. Partly ruined looks authentic.

landmarks.name: St. Basil's Cathedral
features: central tent-roofed (shatyor) tower
eight surrounding chapels, each with a different patterned onion dome
red brick with white stone trim
high galleries and stair porches

palette.domes: bright stripes: green/yellow/red/blue concrete or glazed terracotta

landmarks.minecraft: Fits at 1:1 or 2:1. Onion domes with 'revolve' and 'materials' spiral stripes (mod(a + y*20, 60) < 30).

landmarks.name: Burj Al Arab
features: sail-shaped silhouette: a V-shaped plan with the open side wrapped in a white fabric facade
exoskeleton steel trusses on the outside of the curved back
helipad cantilevered near the top
stands on its own artificial island
landmarks.minecraft: Scale 1:2. The sail curve is a 'shape' or 'loft' with offset dz growing with height.
